=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note a fixed linear congruential generator stands in for a random source (Rosetta asks for
note random numbers 0..19): x' = (1103515245 x + 12345) mod 2^31, r = (x' / 65536) mod 20.
note Print r; stop after printing 10; otherwise print the next value too
fn main to int
x = ulong 42
while true bound 1000
x = and add mul x 1103515245 12345 2147483647
r = rem div x 65536 20
emitu r
emit nl
if eq r 10
break
end
x = and add mul x 1103515245 12345 2147483647
emitu rem div x 65536 20
emit nl
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
